mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS device_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status = 'ONLINE') AS online_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM t_alarm AS a WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' AND a.object_type = 'DEVICE') AS alarm_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM t_facility AS f) AS facility_total, (SELECT count(*) FROM t_facility AS f WHERE f.status = 'ONLINE') AS facility_online_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM t_alarm AS a WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' AND a.object_type = 'FACILITY') AS facility_alarm_count FROM t_device AS d
